card.text: Explore Telesto in 3D with Cassini imagery and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Telesto leads Tethys along its orbit around Saturn. Cassini’s close views revealed a small, irregular icy moon with smooth deposits that soften the outlines of its craters.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading. The gray grid marks missing coverage and terrain hidden in cast shadows.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 12.35 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
